events.event_name: Gather Round: Let’s Dance! at Manhattan West
events.address: Manhattan West Plaza, 385 9th Ave, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A free Wednesday outdoor dance-and-live-music series at Manhattan West Plaza with performances, dance lessons and participatory social dancing. Each date has a different program.
events.what_is_free: Admission, live music, performances and participatory dance lessons/social dancing are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Official Works & Process and Manhattan West sources describe the performances as free to attend/open to the public; no RSVP or ticket requirement is stated. The series is outdoors, so conditions may affect programming. The organizer page describes the performance window as 5 PM to sunset, while Manhattan West and current coverage specify 5–6:15 PM; the occurrence cards use the more specific venue schedule.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday September 16: Sekou McMiller & Friends Mambo Dance Party. September 23: A Barn Dance with Brooklyn Contra. September 30: New York Swings with Josh Lee and the Family. All are scheduled 5–6:15 PM at Manhattan West Plaza.

occurrences.details: WALK-IN. Sekou McMiller & Friends: Mambo Dance Party with live Palladium Mambo Band, lesson and social dancing.
WALK-IN. A Barn Dance with Brooklyn Contra; live Appalachian/Irish music, taught dances and no partner required.
WALK-IN. New York Swings with Josh Lee and the Family; Lindy Hop/authentic jazz dance and live music.
